checks: the agent asks about the host key, with the server's real fingerprint
every stage is reported in the order the protocol performs them
the shell's own output arrives on the terminal stream
input reaches the server and its answer comes back
the terminal can be resized after the shell is up
closing the shell reports an exit status and a closed phase
a changed host key is refused without asking
an accepted host key is not asked about a second time
an encrypted private key is unlocked with its passphrase
a locked key without its passphrase says so, rather than failing obscurely
a keyboard-interactive challenge is put to the caller when it arrives
a wrong code fails the connection instead of appearing to succeed
a rejected password reports a failed phase and the reason
